question: 列出全部科室名称
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM department ORDER BY id

question: 查询物资名称和单价，按单价从高到低排序
gold_sql: SELECT name, unit_price FROM item ORDER BY unit_price DESC

question: 统计各物资的库存总量，返回物资名称和库存量
gold_sql: SELECT i.name, SUM(inv.qty) AS qty FROM inventory inv JOIN item i ON inv.item_id = i.id GROUP BY i.name

question: 统计各物资的库存金额（库存量乘以单价），返回物资名称和金额
gold_sql: SELECT i.name, SUM(inv.qty * i.unit_price) AS amount FROM inventory inv JOIN item i ON inv.item_id = i.id GROUP BY i.name

question: 统计各科室的消耗总金额，返回科室名称和金额
gold_sql: SELECT d.name, SUM(c.amount) AS amount FROM consumption c JOIN department d ON c.dept_id = d.id GROUP BY d.name

question: 统计各科室的消耗总数量，返回科室名称和数量
gold_sql: SELECT d.name, SUM(c.qty) AS qty FROM consumption c JOIN department d ON c.dept_id = d.id GROUP BY d.name

question: 统计各物资的消耗总金额，返回物资名称和金额

question: 统计各供应商的采购总额，返回供应商名称和金额
gold_sql: SELECT s.name, SUM(po.amount) AS amount FROM purchase_order po JOIN supplier s ON po.supplier_id = s.id GROUP BY s.name

question: 统计各供应商的采购订单数量，返回供应商名称和订单数
gold_sql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM purchase_order po JOIN supplier s ON po.supplier_id = s.id GROUP BY s.name

question: 查询履约率高于90的供应商名称和履约率
gold_sql: SELECT name, fulfillment_rate FROM supplier WHERE fulfillment_rate > 90

question: 按月份统计采购金额，返回月份和金额
gold_sql: SELECT to_char(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM purchase_order GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: 按月份统计采购订单数量，返回月份和订单数
gold_sql: SELECT to_char(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM purchase_order GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
